repro-zw2015-n100.source_gate_blocked_reason: CRAN fdapace 0.6.0 maps the paper's optimal K=(5,2;2,1,1) to negative/too-small interior-knot counts and GenBSpline rejects them. A compatible historical implementation was not available, so that source-value diagnostic is not claimed; the common comparison uses the unmodified public package at its documented feasible defaults.

ZY2025-table1-n200-sigma0.1.source_gate_blocked_reason: The printed Example 4.1 additive-function centering constants (0.4 and 2) do not center the stated spline combinations under the registered open cubic B-spline convention. The literal design is run only as a sensitivity; no numerically re-centered ZZW2020 proxy may be used for admission.
